TC-06/S23.title: Native app on the local stack: badge picker, background / reopen, camera scan, phone with a wrong date
TC-06/S23.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Judged 4/10 on Android: the chart badge's native picker lists New Admission / Follow-up / Consult (Hospital and Nursing Home), and Consult picked on the phone is kept after 10 s in the background and after force-closing and reopening the app (stored encType consult) - passed. Phone date one day behind: New Admission set on the phone shows New Admission / H&P (SNF admission) there, while the correctly set web device shows Follow-up / SOAP progress (SNF follow-up), and once the web device opened them the server row was rolled to Follow-up (encTypeDay 2026-10-15), so what the phone set does not read New Admission on the web: 6 cells fail in both contexts - known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8 (the expected Fail per the matrix). 'No clock set' cannot be set up on Android (the OS always keeps a time). Camera: the scan control opened Android's photo picker, not the camera (new, see EFS/S18), so photographing a printed census is not possible from the app on Android; the 'scanned patients land Follow-up' cell also needs the printed sheet and the live vision model (left). iOS half not run: the simulator cannot be tapped here without a permission prompt (no idb / Maestro / WebDriverAgent installed; the simulator-control and computer-use tools ask first), and the only booted simulator runs someone else's dev-pointed build (b8fb762), which was left alone. A separate prompt-free smoke on a new simulator (dvc-tc24-s24-ios-*) showed the iOS build on the local stack opening and listing patients.
TC-06/S23.productIssue: A physician whose phone date is a day behind sets a patient or resident to New Admission; a correctly set device shows Follow-up with the follow-up template pre-selected, and opening it there rolls the stored status to Follow-up (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).
